in_marathi.name: Yuvanraaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvanraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yuvanraaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'yuvan' (young) and 'raaj' (king). It signifies the young king who is yet to claim his throne and rule over his kingdom.
